description: A script for analyzing source files to detect usages of raw fetch calls outside an allowlist within a project, specifically used for guarding and migrating network call sites in a codebase.

methods.name: isRawFetchCall
methods.description: Determines if a given call expression is a raw fetch call (either fetch or globalThis.fetch).

methods.name: findRawFetchCallLines
methods.description: Parses source content to find lines where raw fetch calls are made, using TypeScript's parser.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that executes the callsite guard analysis with specific configuration for source roots and allowed callsites.
